turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Sure. Here is one I do first. "He ___ busy." First word: "He". "He" uses "is". So: "He is busy."
The rule in one line: am with I, is with he, she and it, are with you, we and they.
Right: "You are busy." Wrong: "You busy."
Now you. Write one word:
Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
